PROP-e5782b58-pre-010.text: Discord OAuth callback must validate state parameter to prevent CSRF attacks.

locations.note: Auth callback receives 'code' from Discord OAuth and calls supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code) at line 94. No explicit state parameter validation in application code — state/PKCE handling is delegated entirely to the Supabase SSR library (exchangeCodeForSession).
